event-1.title: Residensi Mutiara Austin Grand Launch
event-1.description: Join us for the grand launch of Residensi Mutiara Austin, a premium 650 unit high rise residential development in Johor Bahru. Experience the architecture, meet our team, and discover exclusive investment opportunities in one of the region's most anticipated property launches.

event-2.title: Ehsan Widuri Putra Nilai Open House
event-2.description: Explore Ehsan Widuri Putra Nilai, a 490 unit mixed use development in the heart of Nilai. Tour completed units, meet current residents, and learn about upcoming phases. This open house is your chance to experience the community and lifestyle we've built.

event-3.title: Property Investment Seminar 2024
event-3.description: Learn investment strategies for Malaysian property from industry experts. Ehsan will present market insights, ROI strategies, and how to identify high potential developments. Perfect for both seasoned investors and those new to property investment.

event-4.title: Taman Mawar Ehsan Phase 4 Preview
event-4.description: A first look at the final phase of Taman Mawar Ehsan — 57 units of single and two storey terrace houses on 99 year leasehold land, from RM 299,800. Phases 1 to 3 are complete and occupied, so you can walk a finished street before you commit.

agenda.title: Lunch & Booking Desk

event-5.title: Taman Universiti Bestari Site Day
event-5.description: Spend a morning on the 53 acre Taman Universiti Bestari site in Kedah. Phases 1 to 4 are handed over, Phase 5 is under construction, and Phases 6 to 8 are open for registration of interest. Hard hats provided for the construction walk.
highlights: Hard hats and safety gear provided

event-6.title: First Time Buyer Financing Clinic
event-6.description: A working session for first time buyers, not a sales pitch. Bring your payslips and we will walk you through loan eligibility, the LPPSA and bank panels, government schemes, and the real cost of buying beyond the sticker price.
